items.text: Is there a strategic plan detailing the program vision, strategic aims, HSSE objectives and targets?
Is there a HSSE execution plan outlining how Contractor Management deliver their roles & responsibilities?
How is Contractor mandatory training (HSSE, Supervisor, CM) conducted and compliance tracked?
Is there specific HSSE audit and inspection schedules? Complied with?
How is HSSE data and reporting managed, monitored & evaluated (including but not limited to Enablon).
Enablon process, management and utilization (users, review and validation process etc.?)
Are incidents investigated - as required by the severity, Incident review panels held and lessons learned shared?
How is HSSE information communicated (alerts, campaigns, LL) and actions tracked where required?
Meeting and communication programs with the contractors, schedule,  attendance, comms, tracking actions etc.? (PD/PM HSSE meetings, Safety Forums, Progress and safety meetings)
How does Contractor ensure that HSSE related non-conformities and corrective action are escalated where required? What is the escalation process and responsibilities?
Is there a Reward & Recognition award program and a consequence process?
Show evidence of Monthly HSSE Executive Leadership Meetings, schedule, MoM and action log
Is there a Contractors / Work Order start up / close out process that ensures HSSE requirements are met. Is there a Subcontractor Consent process managed by Contractor? (Readiness Reviews)
Is there a program and process in place for the quarterly Contractor Performance review, including HSSE performance?
How are leadership engagement tours scheduled, measured/recorded and tracked etc.?
Are approved risks assessments and method statements (RAMS) available for all current tasks?
Are pre start briefings being delivered to employees by supervisors (not H&S) before daily activities start?  Records available at point of work and relevant to tasks?
Is there adequate supervision and safety cover” (as per the HSAS ratios) at point of work?
Is there a process for designation of competent persons on site?
Are competent persons identified for hazardous activities?
Are the competent persons engaged in the work (at point of work) ?
Does an approved emergency response plan exist?
Are employees aware of the plan, and the NEOC emergency numbers (or equivalent) displayed?
Is there an approved scenario schedule for drills and are they performed?  Are scenarios relative to hazards and risks?
Is there a permit to work system?  A permit office/process for coordination, issue and closure?
Does the permit system require positive verification of the safe condition on completion of works?
Is there a system for identification of underground utilities?
Is the utility clearance system integrated with the work permit system?
Does the utility clearance system apply to all ground and structure penetration activities?
Does the contractor have a subcontractor screening and evaluation process, is this monitored?
Was an assessment carried out for HSSE Compliance for each subcontractor engaged on the project prior to commencing work on site?
Was documented criteria used to evaluate the subcontractors past HSE performance and existing or proposed systems?
Have supervision arrangements for each subcontractor been confirmed and documented?
How is each subcontractors HSSE performance tracked and reported throughout the project lifecycle?
Have actions been taken to improve subcontractor HSSE performance that does not meet expectations and have those actions been effective?
Are the electrician and electrical supervisors assessed for the competency and Are the inspections carried out by the electrical supervisor or Engineer on the electrical installations?
Is there an up-to-date register of electrical equipment?
Does the contractor hold regular safety meetings with subcontractors?
HSE Training requirements have been identified, implemented and recorded.
Has a NEOM approved HSE Induction has been delivered to all employees and visitors?  Term before re-fresher required identified and how managed?
Are employees aware of a process for reporting incidents and observations?  Posters/Charts displayed?
Are fire extinguishers and fire fighting equipment properly located inspected and maintained?
Are Oxy-fuel rigs properly set up and stored and flashback arrestors are properly installed?
Are flammables, oxidizers, and combustibles stored properly?
Is there a PPE policy (including NEOM 5 point PPE) is it implemented and managed?
Is task specific PPE provided where required (i.e. SCBA for confined space work etc.)
Is there a suitable medical facilities and ambulance available?
Are there enough qualified medical staff (doctor, nurse, paramedics) on site?
Are there enough first aid trained employees on site, how are the identified?
Is there an occupational and health program/plan implemented and recorded?
Is there a health surveillance program?
Do you have an established Health & Safety Steering Committee, and is senior management represented on it?
What actions were made by the Sr management during the walkthrough
Are there minutes available for the most recent HSE SC, Has the following been reviewed and discussed, Injuries, illnesses, HIPO Nearmisses, HIPO Unsafe behaviours and conditions?
Do you have a schedule for the Audit and Is there an evidence of recent audit report and is it reviewed by the Sr management (E.G Steering committee)?
Do you have a schedule for Senior Management (PD & CEO), and does it include their participation in Health & Safety walkthroughs
What NC's / Opportunity For Improvements and recomendations for Corrective Action's were made by the auditor?
Do  you have a schedule for the Mass TBT and Does the schedule includes participation by the Sr management (External PD & CEO)
Is there evidence of recognition and rewarding for frontline workforce reporting of high potential nearmisses and observations relating to critical controls (signficant Hazards)?
Do managers and supervisors ensure that Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are approved, communicated, and implemented for all work activities?
Are RAMS available for all activities (check the RAMS register)? Take sample of activities on site, a copy of the RAMS must be available on site.

Do the requirements specified in the RAMS accurately reflect the work activity being conducted? (Specific activity covered, all relevant significant hazards identified, all mandated controls in place)
Is there a documented review process for RAMS and does it include authorization by the relevant Construction Manager / Employer?
Is there upto date and Code A Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved HSSE plan ?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved HSSE Monitoring Schedule?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Training Matrix, Records and Plan and Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Induction Presentation?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved HSSE Personnel CV's?
Is there Employer approved HSSE Reward and Recognition Scheme?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Emergency Management and Emergency Response Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Injury / Illness Management Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Subcontractor Management Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Traffic Management and Logistics Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Lifting Operations Management Plan and Lift Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Fatigue Management Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Fire Prevention Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Temporary Electrical Management Safety Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Testing Commissioning Plans?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Temporary Works Procedure / Register / Management Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Weather working Plan?
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Equipment Inspection Program
Is there upto date and Employer (Oxagon Projects) approved Mobilization & Demobilization Plan
